title: I gave Opus 5.5 one prompt and six hours to visualize Invisible Cities
why_read: An exploratory look at a frontier AI model's long-form generative and visualization capabilities, interesting as an AI capability demo.
analysis: This is an experiment giving a large AI model, apparently a recent Opus version, an open-ended creative task over an extended run time to visualize a literary work. It is a capability-probing exercise rather than rigorous benchmarking, so conclusions are anecdotal. Still, long-horizon unsupervised generation tasks like this reveal interesting things about model planning, consistency, and failure modes over time. Likely of interest to people tracking what frontier models can autonomously produce.
